teaser: A casserole dish, still warm, travels across town because you heard someone wasn't eating. Life path 6 built you to carry other people's weight like it was always yours to carry; ESFP built you to do it with a laugh, a story, a hand on the shoulder that makes the weight feel lighter than it is. The particular thing about this crossing is how little it looks like duty. It looks like a party. It looks like you showing up with food and jokes and somehow also doing the dishes after. The care is real. The performance of ease around it is real too.
